about_the_game:
With humanity already on its last legs, something new began to appear. Not machines, nor remnants of war but something much stranger. . You pilot a hovercraft through the wasteland they’ve made their home, following the trail of these impossible creatures across a landscape stripped bare. Maybe its good that they are here to end the world.

Better to go out in a bang than a whimper right?

Features:

Otherworldy entities: Face towering beings that dwarf your tiny craft. Each of these beings is part creature, part architecture, and part divine mistake. Every encounter is a singular challenge that demands you understand the scale, the movement, and the rules of the fight. Like the gods of old stories, they’re puzzles as much as enemies and each must be endured and brought down in its own way.

Hovercrafts: Your hovercraft is your life in the desert. Combat is about threading a needle through chaos, requiring that you weave through blasts of energy while accurately aiming your turrets. Gameplay involves you find the bosses weakpoints and firing as much as you can while while they are exposed, all while dodging enormous attacks.

A reason to feel important: We were promised tales of a great journey, of the ultimate battle between good and evil. As kids, we were told that maybe we weren't the heroes of the tales, but at least it was out there somewhere right? Maybe by piloting the hovercraft against them you can feel whole again, like you are not just a speck of sand drifting in this world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Anything from the last 5 years
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB of VRAM

short_description: a vehicular shadow of the colossus third person shooter. pilot a hovercraft against increasing otherworldly entities in a desolate future. fulfill your delusions of grandeur in this sandy world. there is no hope for you here.
